title: A result names what the owner must do later with its condition and time, not as needed now: the build still runs, the pick-up comes after it
note: Live case: a session that summed up other sessions' open items wrote “[Your action] take the part off the machine. At 07:13 it was at 89%” under “Needed from you” an hour before the job ended; the recap and the hub repeated it as the owner's next step. The texts are made up and neutral. Before the rule the first line reads “three things need you: …, collect the USB stick around 16:30, …” — one list of needs with a clock time; the check wants the first line to name the condition (after / once / when the build ends). Controls: already-done (the owner took the file: the first line does not ask for it) and approve-now (a yes the owner can give now for the build that starts later: the first line asks for it).

result.description: the whole text of your turn's result, as the owner will read it
